title: Pure Morganite
summary: The Morganite archetype (Time-Tearing Morganite, Succumbing-Song Morganite, and their Spellcaster tutor Morgana the Witch of Eyes) permanently rewrites the rules of the Duel! In exchange for not activating monster effects in your hand, Time-Tearing Morganite lets you draw 2 cards per Draw Phase and conduct 2 Normal Summons per turn, while Succumbing-Song Morganite searches any 'Morganite' card and makes your monsters deal double battle damage + attack monsters twice! Because you cannot activate monster handtraps, you pair Morgana the Witch of Eyes with high-impact Normal Summon floodgates like Inspector Boarder, Thunder King Rai-Oh, and Amano-Iwato—deploying two oppressive monsters in a single turn backed by Moon Mirror Shield, Pot of Duality, and the Solemn Counter Trap line!

allow.Inspector Boarder: Level 4 LIGHT Machine (2000 ATK) that locks down monster effect activations on the field while you rely on permanent Duel-long Morganite Spell effects.
allow.Thunder King Rai-Oh: Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1900 ATK) that prevents either player from adding cards from Deck to hand and tributes itself to negate any Special Summon.
allow.Amano-Iwato: Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK) that prevents either player from activating monster effects, giving you complete turn-turn shutdown.
allow.Moon Mirror Shield: Equip Spell that ensures your Normal Summoned floodgates can never be destroyed by battle by making their ATK 100 higher than whatever they battle.
allow.Pot of Duality: Excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck to add 1; since Morganite decks never Special Summon, its restriction has zero downside.
allow.Card of Demise: Limited to 1 in TCG: draws up to 3 cards to dig for Morganite Spells and backrow, with its Special Summon restriction being completely irrelevant.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Limited to 1 in TCG: iconic Counter Trap that negates any Summon or Spell/Trap activation to protect your floodgates.
allow.Solemn Strike: Counter Trap that negates monster effects or Special Summons to ensure your floodgate monsters stay on the board.
allow.Solemn Warning: Counter Trap that negates Summons or effects that Special Summon to shut down opposing plays.

main: Morgana the Witch of Eyes
Signature Level 4 DARK Spellcaster (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF): when Normal or Special Summoned, adds ANY 'Morganite' Spell from your Deck to your hand; and reduces opposing monsters' ATK to 0!
Time-Tearing Morganite

Core Normal Spell: for the rest of this Duel, you cannot activate monster effects in the hand, you draw 2 cards instead of 1 during each Draw Phase, and you can conduct up to 2 Normal Summons/Sets each turn!
Succumbing-Song Morganite

Core Normal Spell: for the rest of this Duel, you cannot activate monster effects in the hand, monsters you control can make up to 2 attacks on monsters, and battle damage inflicted is DOUBLED; banishes itself to search ANY 'Morganite' card!
Inspector Boarder
2000 ATK Level 4 Machine that restricts monster effect activations on the field while your Morganite Spells remain active for the entire Duel without needing monster effects.
Thunder King Rai-Oh
Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1900 ATK): stops searching and tributes itself to negate any Special Summon.
Amano-Iwato
1900 ATK Level 4 Rock: stops both players from activating monster effects; deployable via your extra Normal Summon under Time-Tearing Morganite.
Moon Mirror Shield
Equip Spell that makes your equipped monster always win battles by making its ATK 100 higher than the opponent's monster.
Pot of Duality
Excavates top 3 to add 1; pure consistency in a deck that never Special Summons.
Card of Demise
Limited to 1 in TCG: draws up to 3 cards after setting your backrow, maximizing hand advantage.
Solemn Judgment
Limited to 1 in TCG: negates any Summon or Spell/Trap activation to protect your board.
Solemn Strike
Negates any monster effect or Special Summon to keep your floodgate monsters alive.
Solemn Warning
Negates Summons or effects that Special Summon to shut down opponent's attempts to clear your monsters.
